# BlackMail

> BlackMail is a fast, privacy-focused, and secure temporary email service. Generate disposable email addresses instantly with zero sign-up or registration.

## Service
- **Instant temporary email**: Generate a disposable address without creating an account.
- **Temporary inbox**: View messages received by the generated address.
- **Automatic expiry**: Temporary addresses expire; use a permanent address for important accounts or account recovery.
- **Privacy**: Keep a temporary registration separate from your personal inbox.

- [Home](https://blackmail.pcodes.tech/): Generate temporary email addresses and view the inbox.
